audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows are inverted against their own reasons. Both layers read Neeko / Skill / Riven / Riven / Neeko / Riven / Riven, while whys[0] says Level 1 is an even start to concede, whys[1] says she 'can't all-in yet', whys[2] gives Neeko 'a trade she can't answer', whys[3] says 'You out-poke and out-zone a pre-item Riven', and whys[5] says Neeko's item spike 'outpaces her itemization'. Only whys[6] is Riven's. The packet chart (Skill / Neeko x5 / Riven) matches all seven and matches a 68.42% win rate. The header agreed with the wrong chart: TRICKY 7/10, orange, 7.5/10 carry threat on Neeko's best matchup in this slice.
audit.why: Riven is a cooldown-and-resource duellist against a champion whose entire plan is punishing a spent dash. The page's prose has that exactly right; the chart and the header describe a different, losing lane.
audit.corrected: Skill / Neeko / Neeko / Neeko / Neeko / Neeko / Riven, as matched full+content pairs with ratings; diff TRICKY -> FAVOURED, tone to green, diffRating 7/10 -> 4/10, carryRating 7.5/10 -> 6.5/10, both rating lines rewritten.

audit.why: Four spikes with the right timings: her Level 3 root window, her Level 6 kill button, her first item, and Riven's all-in window. The 2+ items row is the only Riven row on the corrected chart and spikes[3] is the reason for it.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; the combo description inside spikes[3].text corrected to real ability names.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) The packet defect note is right that no Riven ability is ever named on the full layer beyond 'Ki Burst (Stun)'. (b) dosFull[1].t reads 'Root the landing spot of Ki Burst (Stun)' — Ki Burst is a self-centred 260-range AoE stun with no landing spot at all; the thing with a landing spot is Broken Wings. (c) whys[6] and late both say she bursts you 'before you can re-shield'. Neeko has no shield in her kit; the shield in this matchup is Valor, hers. (d) NO COOLDOWNS anywhere, on a page whose entire stated plan is 'bait it, then commit'. (e) Blade of the Exile is never mentioned once — it grants Attack Damage and RANGE plus a one-shot Wind Slash, which is precisely why spacing that worked all lane stops working when she ults.
audit.why: Telling a Neeko to root a landing spot that does not exist, on the wrong ability, is the difference between punishing a spent Broken Wings and throwing her only CC at a Riven with three charges in hand. And a player who believes they re-shield will price the late-game duel around absorption they never had.
audit.corrected: Ki Burst: 260 range, self-centred, 11/10/9/8/7s — bait it, then fight inside those 11 seconds. Broken Wings: 275 range, 13s, three casts with the third knocking back — that is the dash to bait, and a rooted Riven with the charges spent has nowhere to go. Valor: 250 range, 10/9/8/7/6s, steps forward and blocks damage — commit your burst on its downtime. Blade of the Exile adds AD and range and a ranged Wind Slash, so late she out-spaces you.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text, ranges and cooldowns
